headline: Trump Calls Her a Traitor, She Quits

beats.text: Marjorie Taylor Greene spent years as Trump's loudest defender. Then she wouldn't drop the Epstein files.

beats.caption: calling Green wacky and a traitor
beats.label: via CBS Philadelphia

beats.text: Turns out loyalty has a shelf life, and hers just expired.

beats.caption: I fully stand with women who were raped as teenagers
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: Her actual crime? Wanting the files released, like Trump promised voters.

beats.caption: even though the president called me a traitor for standing with those victims
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: On January fifth, the fight that started with a tweet ended with an empty seat.

beats.caption: This is Marjorie Taylor Green's last day in Congress.
beats.label: via CBS Chicago

beats.text: Before she left, she got one nice moment in.

beats.caption: that's thank you for the honor of the lifetime allowing me to serve them in the 14th district
beats.label: via CNN

beats.text: Trump's review of losing his loudest defender: great news.
